title: Chicken coop
description: Chunky Kenney-style hen house on short dark stilts: orange-red walls with cream corner boards and trim, dark red-brown stepped-shingle gable roof (ridge along X), a sliding pop door and small window on the front (+Z), a slatted cream ramp down to the ground. Hollow: straw floor and a two-rail ladder roost along the back wall. Nodes roof, walls/wall_*, interior, pop_door drive the game's cutaway and door.
checks: FRONT tile: a tan pop door panel with dark battens sits right of centre (model's left, +X) at floor height between cream guide runners, and a small cream-framed window with a cross sits left of centre
FRONT tile: cream corner boards run up both front corners and a cream eave board runs along the wall top
3/4 tile: the coop stands on short dark stilts under a dark-brown floor slab, the walls clearly orange-red
3/4 tile: the roof is a two-sided gable with its ridge running left-right, darker than the walls, overhanging all round, with stepped shingle rows
LEFT tile: the ramp's top meets the pop door sill and its low end touches the grid line; stilts touch the grid line
LEFT tile: the gable end is a closed triangle under the roof with cream rake trim on the roof edge
interior zoom (top, roof hidden): a straw-yellow floor fills the inside and two parallel round perch rails span most of the width along the back wall on small A-frame legs
far view: reads as an orange coop with a dark roof and a cream ramp, not a blob
